messages.subject: Spatiotemporal analysis using INLA
parts:
Dear all,
I am a beginner in spatiotemporal analysis using INLA. 
How can I incorporate the temporal component in the formula in spatiotemporal analysis?
I am doing a spatiotemporal analysis to examine the association of environmental variables with geographical variation in a specific disease entity. I used data from 2010-2022, including 1100 areas (spatial units). 
Am I expected to put each year in a separate column and consider it as an independent variable while constructing the formula? 
I would be happy if you send me example codes for spatiotemporal analysis in INLA. 
Thank you!
Wubet
